text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Oh! Daring Heart is running in today's 
Mile Championship too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ah... who was that girl again...? Pretty 
sure I heard her name recently, too...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You know, from last year's Triple Tiara 
generation! —Like Craft and Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, totally, I totally get it! Wait, 
hold on, today was supposed to be... Kraft 
was originally supposed to run too, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
—Maybe that would've worked for 
Craft-chan, but... isn't Heart-chan having 
a rough time with it?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
There's a former Satsuki Sho winner in the 
mix, and competing alongside those from 
the Classic Triple Crown route... makes 
the baseline strength a bit, well, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —She has real ability.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Huh... Messiah-san?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Huh... Messiah?!?!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
She is an exceptionally strong Umamusume. 
If she weren't—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way I could remember the match 
so vividly... or recall the fiery passion 
of competing against her like this."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "...Heart-san is strong. Because—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
She was the rival who continually 
challenged Ms. Craft to a head-on 
showdown, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...So please, have peace of mind and 
cheer on Miss Heart."

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: H-Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. What's the matter, Messiah-san? 
You got all fired up, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I didn't mean to... ...Perhaps 
I've already been swept up by her passion.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "...Still, I wonder if Mr. Craft is here?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Even if the hotel is right nearby, if you 
don't hurry, the race will already—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: He'll come. ...Craft will definitely come.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Messiah-san said so too, right? That 
Heart-san kept challenging Craft.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"The one who felt Heart-san's passion the 
most... was you, Craft, wasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "It's okay. Craft... will definitely run."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After discussing our strategy, right 
before seeing her off to the paddock—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Won't you rile me up a bit?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Yes. ...I want some courage."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I like to think I understand how brutal 
the race that's about to start really is."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still, that girl is watching me today. 
...I know she is.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So—I can't afford to lose. I want to show 
you... me winning……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Show me what the greatest rival looks 
like! Make them want to battle on the turf 
once more!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...So please, give me courage. 
Unbreakable courage—with your words."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment I realized, I made up my mind. 
If it's to encourage her—I can be as bold 
and confident as it takes!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: If it's you, you can do anything!
If it's you, you can do anything!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"You got it! I'll go carry on—the baton of 
my youth!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...I have to go. I must answer 
Heart-san's feelings."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Still...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
......If it's just watching the paddock 
footage... Surely...... it'll be fine... 
right?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —...Hiyah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(...Craft. True to my promise, I'm here. 
To stand before you—as the ultimate 
Queen.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(I'll make you remember. Our youth, so 
utterly precious and uniquely ours... with 
these very legs!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hi, everyone! I'm sure I don't need to 
introduce myself by now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"The fire engraved upon your heart... 
Today, I shall bring those days back to 
life!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Are you ready? Go wild—for my heart!
